notes.title: Patch 1.02r9
notes.content:
Removed all layers except current level and the immediate background/foreground layers.  Should help with ingame visibility.

Camera zoom now has an additional setting.  The new zoom level is halfway between the two pre-existing zoom levels.  Controls remain the same.
